name: South Jetty
factors: Jetty-built sandbar that shifts every winter. Wind is the whole story — anything over 12kt onshore and it's gone.

name: Oxnard Shores
factors: Open beach break that takes west swell straight on. Punchy on a low tide, closes out fast once it gets big.

name: Emma Wood
factors: Cobblestone point off the river mouth. Needs west swell and a mid tide; the inside runs long when the sand is right.

name: County Line
factors: Reef and cobble sections spread down the highway. Handles a bump of wind better than the beaches either side.

name: Oil Piers
factors: Old piling sandbars still shape the peaks. Fickle — best on a long-period west swell with a light morning offshore.

name: Rincon
factors: The classic cobblestone point. Long-period west swell wraps around the Rivermouth and links all the way through.
